Self.Wiki: An item pickup. The treasure places the items of its item lots as a glowing pickup at the treasure part, such as an item corpse or a chest. Taking it awards the lots and sets the lot's Get Item Flag, after which the pickup no longer appears. A chest treasure usually starts disabled and becomes available when the chest is opened.

TreasurePartName.Wiki: The part the pickup is placed at, normally an Object or Dummy Object (item corpse, chest). For a chest, this is the chest object that is opened. With no part, no pickup appears.

ItemLots.Wiki: The ItemLotParam rows given by the treasure (5 slots), -1 for an empty slot. Retail almost only uses the first slot; a few treasures use the second.

InChest.Wiki: If ON, the item is inside a chest. In retail it is nearly always used together with Start Disabled, so the item can only be taken after the chest is opened.

StartDisabled.Wiki: If ON, the pickup is placed hidden and can't be taken until something enables it, such as the chest opening. Turn it off for items that should be available at once.
